summary: The NIFTY index on two clients: an LTP holder, then a Quote holder (the desktop moves the touchline subscription from LTP to Quote with an unsubscribe and a subscribe); the snapshot and a partial serve both, each at its mode, with the change fields an index carries; the Quote holder leaving moves it back.

notes: Noren's index touchline carries no volume, average price, last quantity or totals.
Noren's own pc goes out as percent_change, as on the web; the desktop derives it only when a frame has none (audit FB-07).
Upstream the desktop answers an LTP-to-Quote change with u then t for the same touchline; the web sends nothing (both modes ride one touchline subscription).

deviations.reason: Noren's index touchline carries no average price; the web's Zebu adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.

Noren's index touchline carries no last quantity; the web's Zebu adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.
The frame carries no ltt: the web's Zebu adapter sends last_trade_time as null (data.get(ltt)); the desktop sends no null keys and leaves it out (lead ruling 2026-11-09).

Noren's index touchline carries no volume; the web's Zebu adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.
The web's server also sends this client a richer mode's publication of the instrument, beyond the modes it holds; the desktop sends one frame per held mode.
deviations.ref: websocket_proxy/server.py zmq_listener (for m in range(1, mode + 1))
